_note: Aesthetic catalog for new videos (tools/new_video.py plan). Each aesthetic is a look + a family of settings; a video = one aesthetic + one concrete brief (scenes/<scene>/brief.json). Evidence and ranking: docs/research-aesthetics.md (2026-10-16). Prompts follow the keyart-pipeline rules: 16:9, locked-off camera, foreground/midground/background, light sources, 1-2 animatable props besides the pet, clear areas for animation, no people (user 2026-10-16: avoid humans, pets are fine). Franchise looks may be named in prompts and only as a secondary part of titles (user 2026-10-16). 'motions' uses the module names in src/library/autoscene.js; 'ai_label' is the suggested YouTube 'altered or synthetic content' answer (realistic scenes: true). 'music' is the look's music style; 'music_dirs' (set once Truman has picked tracks for the look from clips) lists its folders under music/ (tools/music.py scene_music); the root music/ folder is the Mojang allowlist, for Minecraft looks only. 'title_font' is the font of the intro title (config/fonts.json, tools/intro_title.py): pixel looks use the channel's own pixel font. 'intro' (optional) styles the look's opening line with tools/intro_title.py's keys, merged in by tools/autopilot.py's setup (the comic look's caption box, 2026-10-25). 'thumb' is how the look's thumbnails look (user 2026-10-20: they fit the video's look, not always the pixel style): its fonts (config/fonts.json; tools/thumbnail.py `font`) and motifs from its own world to draw the text on; every thumbnail still says 4K and 10 HR. A look with tier 'idea' needs new code first: 'needs' lists the repo files that must exist before new_video.py plan accepts it (docs/IDEAS.md).
boilerplate: Locked-off camera at eye level, wide 16:9 composition with a clear foreground, midground and background. Leave open, uncluttered areas around the light sources, the windows and the animal so they can be animated. No people anywhere: no pedestrians or silhouettes outside, no portraits, posters or statues of people. No other animals besides the one pet: no birds, insects, snails or frogs anywhere (small creatures are animated in afterwards). No lightning bolts. Things that move are animated afterwards, so do not paint them frozen: no visible steam or smoke plumes, no water drops hanging from edges and no streams of dripping water; surfaces may look wet. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no user interface.

ink-gouache.music: lofi with soft acoustic guitar and warm piano, gentle and sleepy (no heavy drums)
ink-gouache.avoid: It must look like a real illustrator spent days on it, with deliberate choices everywhere. Avoid every look of generic AI art: no glossy or plastic surfaces, no sparkles or glitter, no bokeh, no lens flare, no bloom halos, no glowing particles or dust motes, no god rays, no wet reflections full of glints, no sunset gradient sky, no teal-and-orange grading, no HDR rendering of every surface, no smooth airbrushed gradients, no uniform machine-clean outlines, no big shiny anime eyes, no blush stickers. Leave large areas simple and quiet; put the detail only where the eye should go.
ink-gouache.brief_rules: Write the scene as one moment with a small story that makes sense in real life (reading, a handheld game, warming up at a fire, waiting for a pot of soup to cook; never something nobody does, like roasting a blackberry), and prefer what gives the code something to animate: steam from a pot or a mug, a candle, a fire, a lantern, rain on a window. Strip the scene to what the story needs and name what is not there (bare plank walls, no shelves, no plants, no pictures) so the image model doesn't fill it with stock clutter. Every word becomes a thing in the picture: never mention the moon, stars or rain streaks unless they should be drawn. One main light source, how far its light reaches, and how much of the frame is dark. The characters are 2 to 4 of the channel's own creatures (the hint's, when it names them) from config/cast.json, by id in the brief's 'cast', awake doing something quiet (breathing and blinks are drawn in code), never a real animal or a person; say where each one sits and what it does. The falling rain is never drawn (it is animated): say the air is clear and the ground wet.
ink-gouache.style_prompt: Style: a hand-made picture-book illustration, inked and painted. Line art in dark umber and deep forest-green ink, never pure black: the lines vary in weight, taper at their ends and sometimes break off or stop short of closing a shape. Colors are opaque gouache with visible dry-brush strokes and the grain of watercolor paper showing through. The characters are inked carefully; the background is painted looser, with fewer lines, soft brush edges and simple masses. Wood grain, knit and cloth are suggested with a few confident strokes, not rendered everywhere. Muted, earthy palette: rust, ochre, moss green, slate blue and warm brown, with cool blue-gray shadows.

motifs: a storybook cover with a hand-lettered title

a page with a small inked vignette of the cast
